path: iclr2026/Fastavatar_towards Unified and Fast 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Large Gaussian Reconstruction Transformers.pdf
title: Fastavatar: towards Unified and Fast 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Large Gaussian Reconstruction Transformers
one_line: 常规3D高斯重建框架，增量机制提升效率但创新有限
method_framework: 基于Transformer的统一框架，处理任意长度输入，通过3DGS预测和融合实现增量重建
experiment_framework: NeRSemble数据集，对比LAM、MonoGaussianAvatar和GaussianAvatars，使用PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS和身份保持指标
takeaways: 增量重建策略提升数据利用效率
多粒度编码改善跨帧信息聚合
weaknesses: 未充分讨论模型在不同数据质量下的鲁棒性
relevance_reason: 3D重建与可靠性主线无关，无可迁移机制
